description: NaLi₂FeCPO₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.47 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There is one shorter (1.94 Å) and two longer (2.01 Å) Li-O bond lengths. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent FeO₆ octahedra, corners with three equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one FeO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 65-88°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.28 Å. Fe is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted FeO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 2.08-2.38 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.29-1.31 Å. P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FeO₆ octahedra and corners with three equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 35-60°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.57 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Li, and one C atom to form distorted ONaLi₂C tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent OLi₂FeP tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONaLiFeC trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaLiFeP tetrahedra. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Li, one Fe, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one C atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaLiFeC trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted OLi₂FeP tetrahedra that share corners with five ONaLi₂C tetrahedra and corners with two equivalent ONaLiFeC trigonal pyramids. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Fe, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom to form distorted ONaLiFeP tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent OLi₂FeP tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent ONaLiFeC trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONaLi₂C tetrahedra. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Li, one Fe, and one P atom.
